title: Ky Nang Tan Gai Cao Cap - Ban sieu sach

chapters.title: Dinh nghia, cau truc tam ly cua gai
core_themes: Gai la con nguoi va bi chi phoi boi thep boi canh tam ly: Thi, Dục, Huyễn, Ngã
Ngoai hinh, gia tri ca nhan, va cach tu tin tac dong den suc hut
Nhu cau cam xuc va nhu cau duoc ton trong deu quan trong
key_points: Thi: thich cai dep va bi hut boi ngoai hinh, phong thai, hinh anh
Duc: co nhu cau tinh cam va nhu cau giai toa tam ly
Huyen: muon duoc nguoi khac ne trong, khen ngoi, co danh tieng
Nga: quan tam den an toan, tuong lai, nang luc va hoai bao
safe_takeaways: Tap trung xay gia tri ban than truoc khi theo duoi ai do
Khong coi hen ho la tro choi danh bai
Quan sat hanh vi that, khong doan y qua ao tuong

chapters.title: Nhung dieu can biet truoc khi tan gai
core_themes: Can nen tang nhan qua va cach ung xu truoc khi vao moi quan he
Hieu quy luat nhan qua va gia tri hanh dong
Khong vo vap khi ban than chua on dinh
key_points: Neu ban than mat can bang, de sinh vo vap va mat diem
Nen gioi thieu ban than bang hoai bao va hanh dong cu the
Doi phuong thuong danh gia huong phat trien lau dai, khong chi tinh trang hien tai
safe_takeaways: Giu nhip on dinh, noi nang ro rang
Khong day doi phuong vao ap luc
The hien tinh than phat trien, khong than than

chapters.title: Nhung nghich ly vinh hang trong tam ly phu nu
core_themes: Cam xuc con nguoi co the mau thuan va khong tuyen tinh
Su tot bung chua du, can co suc hut va ran giu ranh gioi
Mau thuan giua an toan va khao khat trai nghiem la thuong gap
key_points: 'Tot' nhung thieu hap dan va ranh gioi de vao friendzone
Suc hut ben vung den tu su ket hop: ton trong + thu hut + ca tinh
Nhung lua chon cam tinh thuong khong hoan toan logic
safe_takeaways: Can bang giua quan tam va tu chu
Khong vo vanh vai nguoi cuu ho cam xuc
Giu ranh gioi va suc hut song song

chapters.title: Ke thien
core_themes: Danh gia boi canh truoc khi hanh dong
Khong phai luc nao cung tang toc
An toan tam ly va phan hoi cua doi phuong la du lieu quan trong
key_points: Chon thoi diem, khong gian va cach tiep can phu hop
De y tin hieu hai chieu thay vi ep muc tieu
Tinh huong on dinh moi nen day nhip
safe_takeaways: Uu tien boi canh thoai mai, an toan
Doc phan hoi som de dieu chinh
Khong giong nhu doan canh cuoi truoc khi co du manh moi

chapters.title: Muu cong tac chien
core_themes: Theo duoi can chien luoc, khong chi can co gang
Khoang cach, thoi gian va su khong ro rang lam hao ton nang luong
Can co tieu chi ro ve tien trien
key_points: Neu chi chat ma khong gap, can xem lai do uu tien
Muon tien trien phai co tuong tac deu va co chat luong
Hanh dong phai nhat quan voi muc tieu
safe_takeaways: Dat moc gap cu the thay vi keo dai muon man
Tranh lam nguoi kia cam thay bi truy sat
Quan tam nhung khong qua lam

chapters.title: Tieu nhan ke
core_themes: Canh bao tam the chi muon ket qua nhanh
Tam tham cau va thao tung lam sap do ben trong
Kiem soat ban than quan trong hon meo vat
key_points: Thao tung va tham cau de dan den met moi va do vo
Neu mat can bang, can dung lai de chinh minh
Dau tranh tam ly khong the thay the bang co chap
safe_takeaways: Kiem tra dong co cua minh truoc khi tiep tuc
Khong su dung cach lam gia, lua doi hay ep buoc
Giữ ky luat ca nhan khi gap tuoi thu thach

chapters.title: Thuong dang ru tinh ke
core_themes: Nang cap tu chieu thuc len chieu sau
Gia tri, nhan cach va ban linh tao suc hut ben vung
Tinh yeu lau dai can su an tam va ton trong
key_points: Thu hut ben vung den tu tu duy va loi song
Dau tu dai han vao su nghiep va tri tue cam xuc
Khong chi dua vao meo vat ngan han
safe_takeaways: Xay cuoc song rieng co chat luong
Giu binh tinh va su sang suot trong moi tuong tac
Ton trong do phuc tap cua con nguoi

global_principles: Dong thuan ro rang > doan y
Gia tri ban than > meo vat ngan han

usage.recommended_input: Chap nhan mot chapter hoac mot tinh huong cu the, roi truy xuat theo key_points + safe_takeaways
notes: Dung nhu bo tri thuc tham khao, khong dung de thao tung hay ep buoc
Neu can tom tat nhanh, doc truong title + key_points truoc
